title: Revvity Announces Financial Results for the First Quarter of 2026
summary: Revenue of $711 million; pro forma revenue of $687 million; 7% revenue growth; 3% organic growth; 6% pro forma organic growth GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $0.37; adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.06; GAAP pro forma EPS from continuing operations of $0.40; pro forma adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.04 Announces intention to divest China Immunodiagnostics business Updates full year 2026 guidance Revvity, Inc. (NYSE: RVTY), today reported financial results for the first quarter ended April 5, 2026. The Company reported GAAP earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.37, as compared to $0.35 in the same period a year ago. Revenue for the quarter was $711 million, as compared to $665 million in the same period a year ago. GAAP operating income from continuing operations for the quarter was $76 million, as compared to $72 million for the same period a year ago.
